en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. al-Hasan b. Ahmad b. al-Walid (ra) narrated to us. He said: Ahmad b. Idris narrated to us. He said: Ja`far b. Muhammad b. Malik al-Fazari narrated to us from Muhammad b. al-Husayn b. Zayd from Muhammad b. Sinan from al-`Ala’ b. al-Fudayl from al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad (as). He said:
He who loves a disbeliever has hated Allah, and he who hates a disbeliever has loved Allah.
Then, he (as) said: The confidant of the enemy of Allah is the enemy of Allah.
